description:
Avalore is seeking a full stack developer supporting a backend development team focused on middleware and backend services for our US Government client.
 Requirements 
 Active Security Clearance with appropriate Polygraph 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
 Demonstrated experience and strong technical background in full-stack development, with experience in multiple programming languages and technologies.
 Demonstrated experience with developing applications using program languages, including Java, and Java using Spring and Python.
 Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing technical architectures for complex systems, including web applications, collection systems, network solutions, and cloud-based solutions.
 Demonstrated hands-on experience with AWS cloud solutions, including design, implementation, and management.
 Demonstrated experience with Al, machine learning, or other emerging technologies, with a willingness to explore and adopt new technologies.
 Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with development teams, stakeholders, and external partners.
 Demonstrated ability to develop and articulate a clear technical vision and recommendations, aligning with customer technical requirements and business objectives.
 Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical issues and develop effective solutions
 Demonstrated experience with Agile development methodologies and JIRA.
 Demonstrated experience working in a fast-paced, technically challenging area; ability to anticipate and manage changes or problems; assess impacts and recommend sound solutions.
 Desired:
 Demonstrated experience with authentication and authorization process.
 Demonstrated experience with customer networks, systems and services.
 Advanced degree (MS or Ph.D.) in a A.I., Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or relevant field
 Certifications
 AWS Certified Solutions Architect
 The Open Group Architecture Framework (TOGAF)
 Or relevant certification
 
 Work Environment: 
 Moderate noise (i.e. business office with computers, phone and printers) and /or occasional Loud noise (airfield, large equipment). 
 Ability to sit at a computer terminal for an extended period of time. 
 
 Physical Demands: 
 While performing the responsibilities of the job, the employee is required to sit, stand, talk, and hear. 
 Employee is often required to sit and use their hands and fingers to operate a computer. 
 Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 
 
 Travel: 
 Up to 10%/ Occasional travel. 
 
 Avalore will provide reasonable accommodations to applicants who are unable to utilize our online application system due to a disability. Please send your request to hr@avalore.ai. 
 Avalore is an Equal Opportunity Employer - We not discriminate based on age, race, national or ethnic origin, gender, veterans status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other legally protected class. Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws.
 Benefits 
 Eligibility requirements apply.
 
 Employer Contributions to Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
 Retirement Plan (401k, IRA) with a generous matching program
 Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
 Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
 Short Term & Long Term Disability
 Training & Development
 Employee Assistance Program
 Salary at Avalore is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual's particular combinaition of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements.
